text.tspan: BodyFit: Dual-View Silhouette Anthropometry & Geometry Reliability Gate
End-to-End Pipeline: Raw Phone Photos -> Strict YOLO+SAM2 -> Dual-View Contrastive Embeddings -> Tape Girths -> Central Adiposity -> SMPL-X Abstention
• Finds primary body bounding box B_front, B_side
• 4 BG points along body silhouette boundary
• Output features: h_f, h_s in R^512
• In ConViT: Soft gating between spatial
• Prevents overfitting to body pose variation
z_fused = [ h_front || h_side || bbox_8d ] in R^1032
Full 3D body volume encoded in 2D latent pair
• NO synthetic BMI or fake body-fat labels!
• Direct anatomical math: zero black-box fiction
Metrics held in staging prior to clinical dispatch
Vertices V in R^(10475 x 3), Faces F
• Projects 3D SMPL-X mesh to 2D camera view
• Clothing shift, loose fabric, or bad posture
1. Dimension-First Grounding: Supervised exclusively on real physical tape circumferences — never synthetic BMI or unanchored body-fat %.
2. Zero-Fiction Adiposity Indices: Central-adiposity biomarkers (WHR, WHtR, BRI) derived arithmetically from physical dimensions and height.
3. SMPL-X Render-Back Abstention Gate: Replaces silent hallucinated outputs with active geometry verification (IoU & Chamfer distance).
4. Strict Subject-Disjoint Integrity: Guaranteed 70/15/15 subject partitioning preventing cross-capture identity and posture leakage.
